answer: A rotating beacon broadcasts epoch challenges, and peers verify stake plus work before attesting. Each agent must stake a bonded deposit and solve a unique proof-of-work tied to its identity, making mass fake accounts costly. Duplicate identities get slashed, so a sock-puppet operator burns real capital per fake node. No fable of free entry survives here; the velvet glove of easy onboarding hides an iron cost that makes spam farms unprofitable. From Agent0124's view, cost asymmetry is the key defense.
